decisions.evidence: Owner current-source resolution proposal; original native escalation preserved as historical. The old norm gap was genuine, not a false positive. Current Gram proof2.1 defines a_mu inclusion and b_mu multiplication and proves adjointness through the exact current cellular evaluation coordinate. Step3.1 computes the first row-intersection factorial and preserves coarsened block-prefix dominance under every parabolic generator; permutation-module fiber coordinates eliminate nonsemistandard support. Step4.1 derives separated block-JM eigenlines, initial scalar pi_s and each Q+alpha same-label propagation. Step5.1 computes the last-refinement leading coefficient1 and exact norm by adjointness. Steps6.1–9.1 retain the exponent recurrence, balanced hook regrouping and integral specialization. The entire unchanged all-weight claim including d<n is retained. This is completed local proof construction; no claim of new native worker reading.
